command: keryx agents external run claude-cli --task "reply with the single word ok; change nothing" --unattended --json
notes: Flow 366. outcome.json is the outcome of a real dispatch through keryx's own agents-external run command. stream.jsonl is the raw stdout of the same argv run directly a second time (the runtime does not keep raw stdout); stderr.txt is its stderr, a vendor warning about union types in the result schema that does not affect the run. Redacted in the stream: cwd, slash_commands and skills (the operator's local skill names), messaging_socket_path, and the account's rate-limit utilisation and reset times. worktreePath in the outcome is redacted to '<worktree>'.
